Intricate warm aged brass gears, painted polished mirror plates, strong readable monumental silhouette. Strict FRONT orthographic eye-level, all rings square to viewer, balanced neutral machine posture. Full crown, entire arms and base fit comfortably inside SQUARE transparent canvas with 12 percent empty margin all around. Contain sun glow inside central ring; no background halo, smoke, rays or particles. No floor, ground shadow, scenery, text, labels or additional creatures. Warm soft painted shading with clear material separation.
